bends.note: Florence runs nearly due east from Reading to here, just past the Eden Park Entrance T, then turns NE (dx/dy ~-1.25) and leaves the drawn area toward sheet 176/177
Reading runs due south from the top to here, then turns SSW (dx/dy ~-0.30) and runs straight to the bottom of the drawn area at ~(690,4000)
angle point: Deer Creek Road runs SSE (dx/dy ~+0.40) from Florence to here, then turns SSW (dx/dy ~-0.37) and runs straight to the bottom of the drawn area at ~(1411,4000)
Gilbert runs SSW (dx/dy ~-0.68) from the top-right corner past Eden Park Entrance to here, then turns nearer south (dx/dy ~-0.37) to the bottom of the drawn area at ~(2590,4010)
line point where Deer Creek Road leaves the bottom of the drawn area toward sheet 168 (added 2026-10-19 so the 478 m run from the angle point to Elsinore on 168 is not cut by the 450 m gap limit)

notes: Deer Creek valley between Reading Road (west) and Gilbert Avenue (east): Baldwin Piano Co. works, C.L.& N. R.R. tracks and Eden Park. The top street is printed 'DORCHESTER AV.' (50') west of Reading Road and 'FLORENCE AV.' (60', 20 in. pipe) east of it; the name changes at the Reading crossing, so that crossing is listed twice, once under each name. Reading's centre at the crossing is between its west line (~993) and east line (~1233); the block corners north of Florence are ~25 px further west. Florence's corner at the east end opens into a three-way junction: Florence turns NE (bend listed) and Eden Park Entrance (printed 'EDEN PARK ENTRANCE', 80', 10 in./6 in. pipe) leaves SE; the T point is where the Eden Park Entrance centreline (taken along its pipe, which matches the mid-line of its block lines at the west end) meets Florence's straight east-west centreline, ~110 px west of Florence's angle point. Eden Park Entrance runs straight SE to Gilbert Avenue; at Gilbert the 6 in. pipe continues SE into Eden Park but no street is drawn, so it is a T. Gilbert ('GILBERT AV.', 100', 8 in. pipe) centre taken midway between its block lines, which coincides with the pipe. Deer Creek Road: the 60 ft street leaving the south side of Florence (corner addresses 1849/1848, '1837 DEER CREEK' on its west line) is unlabelled in its upper part; south of its angle point it is labelled 'CITY PARK' along its west edge and, on a correction paste, 'DEER CREEK R'D (STREET VACATED)', with '(NOT OPEN)' printed near the angle point; the lower part is drawn as a full 60 ft street (60' printed at the A-B line, addresses 1801-1809 and 1776/1777) and continues onto sheet 168 (labelled 'DEER CREEK R'D (NOT OPEN)' there). Its upper east line is hidden under the Baldwin lumber-pile paste; the centre was taken 110 px (half of 60 ft) east of the west line, checked against the east corner at Florence (1795,840) and the east line below the angle point. The drawn area ends at about y 4000-4040 (the A-B line at y~3830 marks sheet 168); streets running off it are not ends. No street meets Reading Road from either side below Florence on this sheet.
